data.title: Wire a door without exporting game logic
data.summary: A 0.9 m door leaf, hinge pivot, frame and open/closed collision states. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Godot documents 3D scene formats, export conventions and import configuration.

prerequisites: An authorized Blender → Godot or Unity environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: A 0.9 m door leaf, hinge pivot, frame and open/closed collision states.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent interactive door workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: A 0.9 m door leaf, hinge pivot, frame and open/closed collision states. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Model the frame and leaf separately; place the leaf origin at the hinge
Export the leaf transform animation and attach an engine interaction component
Switch collision state at agreed points; block repeated triggers while moving

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned wire a door without exporting game logic candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: A player cannot pass the closed leaf
Opening twice does not double the angle or leave collision behind
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: The mesh and animation export do not carry the interaction script.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: Test the door from both sides with the largest intended player capsule.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me wire a door without exporting game logic in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: A 0.9 m door leaf, hinge pivot, frame and open/closed collision states. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: A player cannot pass the closed leaf; Opening twice does not double the angle or leave collision behind. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
